$Comment: The toast and the sound a player gets when a hand-harvested pumpkin comes up hallowed during
Hallow's Eve. The file name is the moment id, and it is the Cue the pumpkin row
(BonusRows/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Find.json) puts on its find roll; a cue plays only
when the roll beside it handed something over.
The Hallowed Pumpkin goes straight into the bag beside the harvest. Key is a line in this pack's
hallowseve.world.lang, written bare; Sound is any SoundEvent id, played where the player stands.
